contributions.detail: 24 Form A rows sum to 20,917.51 to the cent, equal to BOTH printed figures on the sheet: the footer 'TOTAL $20,917.51' and the in-grid pseudo-row '7/26/2016  Final Total  $20,917.51' (that pseudo-row is a printed total, NOT a transaction, so it is not emitted as a row). The COVER of this copy, page 6, was NEVER UPDATED - it still reads 20,117.51 in both filled cells, exactly 800.00 less, which is precisely the sum of the four rows dated after the report's certified end (100.00 + 300.00 + 100.00 + 300.00). Scored on the schedule total because that is the figure whose SCOPE matches these rows; the cover figure is named above and its 800.00 disagreement is fully accounted for. Scope is cumulative: the ledger restates the cycle from 25-Jan-2016 and runs on to 7/26/2016.

expenditures.detail: THIS SHEET PRINTS TWO TOTALS AND BOTH GATE. After row 48 it prints 'TOTAL $20,117.51'; my first 48 rows sum to exactly 20,117.51. Three further rows are then printed BELOW that total line (Crystal Inn 50, Dave McFadden 82, Drew Sutterfield 200, all dated after the certified period end and all written without a currency symbol or cents), followed by '7/26/2016  Grand Total  20,449.51'; all 51 rows sum to exactly 20,449.51. Scored on the Grand Total because that is the anchor whose scope matches the complete row set, with the intermediate TOTAL reported above. The cover on p6 again was not updated (20,117.51). Neither total was recomputed or overwritten.

gates.page_subtotal: FOUR printed schedule totals, all four gate to the cent and none was adjusted. Report 1: p3 Form A rows 20,117.51 = printed TOTAL $20,117.51; p5 Form B rows 20,117.51 = printed TOTAL $20,117.51. Report 2: p7 Form A 24 rows 20,917.51 = printed TOTAL $20,917.51 (and the in-grid 'Final Total' pseudo-row of the same figure); p8-p9 Form B first 48 rows 20,117.51 = the printed intermediate 'TOTAL $20,117.51', all 51 rows 20,449.51 = the printed 'Grand Total 20,449.51'. The only figure that does NOT agree is report 2's COVER, which was never updated from 20,117.51 - a documented property of the document, reported in recon rather than reconciled away.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py is NOT APPLICABLE to pages 1-5: the filer's typed document has no ruled grid at all, so there are no rules to measure (this is a genuine 'no reliable geometry' case that arises from the document, not from the tool). Instead I ran an INDEPENDENT programmatic ink-band count over the amount column of each scanned page with PIL - counting contiguous horizontal runs of dark pixels inside the amount x-window - and matched it against the rows I emitted: p2 26 bands = 2 header lines + 12 entries x 2 lines; p3 37 bands = 8 Form A entries x 2 + the Form B title + 2 Form B header lines + 9 Form B entries x 2; p4 46 bands = 23 entries x 2; p5 33 bands = 16 entries x 2 + the TOTAL line. Every band is accounted for, so no line was dropped or double-counted. For pages 6-9 the count is exact from the PDF's own text layer: 24 contribution amounts on p7, 44 expenditure amounts on p8, 4 + 3 on p9.
gates.geometry_proof: Report 1 (scan): amount bands were measured programmatically, then crop-proved at 1200 dpi. p2 first row (y 48.18) renders '$3,000.00'; p2 last row (y 86.59) renders '$831.28'; the control one pitch below p2's last row renders EMPTY. p3 renders '$35.00' and '$425.00' at its 8th and 9th Form B bands - the 8th being the row whose amount the scan prints a line lower than the pitch, so this crop specifically proves that irregular row is not shifted. p4 first row renders '$645.54' and last renders '$674.06'. p5 last row (y 63.91) renders '$94.00' and its control renders EMPTY. Report 2 (born-digital): every row's box is the PDF's OWN word bounding box from pdftotext -bbox, converted to page percentages - not an estimate at all.
gates.balance_chain: Report 1 closes exactly: contributions 20,117.51 - expenses 20,117.51 = 0.00, and the cover prints 0.00 in both the THIS and Cumulative balance cells. Report 2's cover prints the same 0.00 balance and the same 20,117.51 figures, but its SCHEDULES have moved on to 20,917.51 and 20,449.51; on those figures the balance would be 468.00, so report 2's balance line is stale along with the rest of its cover. I have NOT recomputed or overwritten it. Cross-filing chain: the 'Totals from Last Report' column is blank on every line of both covers, i.e. the filer asserts no prior report in the cycle, so there is no earlier filing to chain to.

escalation_note: 1200 dpi crops on the scanned pages: p2 row 1, p2 row 12 and its control; p3 Form B rows 8 and 9 (the displaced-amount row and its neighbour); p4 rows 1 and 23; p5 row 16 and its control. No cell needed a legibility escalation - this is typed 12-point text, and every amount was independently confirmed a second way (see notes). The escalations were spent on GEOMETRY proof, which is where the risk actually lay on an unruled page.
notes: *** THE CHUNK FILE SAYS n_reports=1; THE DOCUMENT HOLDS TWO. *** Pages 1-5 are a scan of the signed, clerk-stamped filing (RECEIVED JUN 17 2016, wet signature on p2, certified period 'beginning 25-Jan-2016 and ending 06-17-16'). Pages 6-9 are a SECOND, COMPLETE report instance: p6 is a full second cover, footed 'Page 1', carrying the same candidate, the same office and the same 20,117.51 figures but with the ending date left blank. It is not a photocopy - it is the same workbook RE-PRINTED LATER, after four more contributions and three more expenditures had been entered, running through 7/26/2016 and totalling 20,917.51 and 20,449.51, while its cover was never updated. Several purpose strings were also edited between the two printings ('Radio Ads' -> 'Radio Ads for Caucus Night', 'Re-closeable Bags' -> 'Reclosable Bags', 'Website design/construction' -> 'Website design and construction', 'Tables: Lincoln Day Bkfst.' -> 'Tables and Display area at Lincoln Day Bkfst.'), so the two copies are textually distinguishable and each report_no is transcribed from ITS OWN pages. Per addendum sec.C the top-level recon is report 1, the report whose pages begin the PDF - it is also the copy that is signed, stamped and internally consistent, and the copy whose 20,117.51 matches what the module already publishes for this filing. Report 2's rows are a SUPERSET of report 1's: 20 of 24 contributions and 48 of 51 expenditures are the same transactions, so a naive union across report_no WILL DOUBLE-COUNT - the report_no tag is what prevents that. OFFICE: the form's own Office line reads 'Washington County Commissioner seat C' verbatim on both covers - a county office, in scope, and it CONFIRMS the chunk file's 'Commission Seat C' against the live portal listing, which files Almquist under Seat A (the seat he later held). The chunk file's index_format is 'text' and that is only half true: pages 1-5 carry NO text layer (they are page images) and pages 6-9 carry a full born-digital text layer. TRANSCRIPTION SOURCES, stated plainly: report 1 was read from 200 dpi renders of pages 2-5 (never from the 90 dpi contact sheet) and every one of its 68 rows was then cross-checked against the born-digital text of the same transactions on pages 7-9, an entirely independent rendering path; report 2 was transcribed from the PDF's OWN EMBEDDED TEXT (pdftotext), which for born-digital vector text is exact rather than inferred, and cross-read against the page images for column assignment and row order. That double-sourcing, plus four printed totals that gate to the cent, is why rows carry verified=1 without a per-row legibility crop. PRIVACY: this document prints a full street address and ZIP for nearly every contributor and the candidate's own home address and two phone numbers on the cover - ALL of it discarded at read time per core sec.5; only donor_city and donor_state are retained, and where the address cell names a business rather than a city (row 14, 'Stone Cliffs Real Estate Office') both are honestly blank. In-kind: the 'In Kind?' column exists on both copies and is EMPTY on every row, so no row is marked in-kind and none is inferred.
